proposedEntry.name: macos-hig-designer
proposedEntry.description: Designs and reviews native macOS apps against Apple's Human Interface Guidelines and the macOS Tahoe Liquid Glass system, via a workflow decision tree (review existing code / modernize deprecated APIs / design a new feature). Covers the three Tahoe design tenets (hierarchy via glass materials, harmony via concentric alignment, platform consistency) with when-to-use/when-not-to-use rules for glassEffect; NavigationSplitView, sidebar, and inspector-panel patterns; window/document/menu-bar-extra configuration; the full standard macOS keyboard-shortcut table; control sizing and Liquid Glass component code (buttons, text fields, tables, popovers/sheets); system typography and semantic-color/material tokens; 8-point-grid spacing and safe areas; VoiceOver/keyboard/Dynamic-Type/Reduce-Motion/High-Contrast accessibility APIs; a deprecated-to-modern API replacement table (NavigationView, NSMenu, NSToolbar, NSOpenPanel, etc.); and a 6-section HIG review checklist.
triggers: design a native macOS app screen
review my macOS UI code against the HIG
add Liquid Glass to this macOS interface
inputs: a macOS app feature to design or existing SwiftUI/AppKit code to review or modernize
outputs: HIG-compliant SwiftUI implementation guidance and code patterns
a violations-with-fixes report against the review checklist for existing code
